units.source_text: “听说前面那条街的中学，学生们在下大雪的时候，一大早就裸着身子从宿舍二楼的窗口跳到雪地里。

en.t: I hear that at the middle school on the street up ahead, when it snows heavily, the students jump naked from the second-floor dormitory windows into the snow early in the morning.

units.source_text: 身体一下子完全没进雪中，看不见了。

en.t: Their bodies sink completely into the snow all at once and disappear from sight.

units.source_text: 他们像游泳似地在雪中划着走。

en.t: Then they paddle along through the snow as if they were swimming.

units.source_text: 喏，那边也停着一辆扫雪车呢。”

en.t: Look, there is a snowplow parked over there too.
